meta.method: Geocoded coordinates are accepted only when a current locality result falls inside the validated peninsula region. Curated historical continuities and aliases, including Hanyang to Seoul and 扶寧 to Buan, are retained with their source note. Remaining origins with a validated province/equivalent receive a deterministic point inside that region and are labeled regional_approximation; they are not claims of an exact locality.
